limitations: Rolling annual holdout by chronological cutoff uses revised source editions that were published years after several simulated origins and historical outcomes; training feature revisions can leak later knowledge even if the target year itself is removed before fitting. These are historical model diagnostics, not real ex-ante forecasts, not 12 independent year shocks or 2352 IID countries. The overlap-vintage track duplicates the same country-years and is only a sensitivity control, never an increased test sample. No statistical significance, confidence intervals, causal claims, or 2027 outcomes can be asserted.
